paragraphs.text: The following Ravnican characters are only mentioned in flavor text or on legendary creature cards, appear as minor characters in the storyline , or are otherwise not notable enough to receive their own article.
Flitwing is a faerie working as an Azorius Senate detective .
Jabs is a human puppeteer in the Cult of Rakdos .

The Muckslinger Gang are a goblin , viashino , and beast trio who live in Ravnica's sewers. They petitioned Niv-Mizzet , the living Guildpact , to become the plane's eleventh guild, and were soundly rejected. Their name may be a combination of muckraker , a journalist who exposes corruption, and mudslinger , one who throws insults.
Nephilim Epochal is a elder nephilim . When it awoke, it awoke the five other Nephilim.
